newsitem.title: UK: UK issues new warning over any Eurofighter delay.
newsitem.headline: UK issues new warning over any Eurofighter delay.

text.p: Britain issued its second warning in as many days over possible delays to the four-nation Eurofighter.

"This government is committed to the investment, production, and support phases of the programme, subject to the satisfactory conclusions of the relevant memoranda of understanding and contractual negotiations," defence procurement minister James Arbuthnot said on Tuesday.

"I very much hope that our German, Italian and Spanish partners will be able to make the same commitment soon. We will be working to avoid any further costly delay in this vital programme," he told parliament during a defence debate.
Eurofighter is due to be built by a consortium linking British Aerospace Plc, Germany's Daimler Benz, unit Dasa, Alenia SpA of Italy and Spain's CASA.
On Monday, Defence Secretary Michael Portillo warned that the Eurofighter's export prospects would be endangered by further delays in getting the go-ahead for its production.
At the weekend the chairman of the German parliament's defence committee told BBC television his country would struggle to afford Eurofighter given the need to trim public spending.
